Dragon's Lair (Cinematronics, 1983) - US LD-V1000 revisions

Milestone 1 build. The real game program runs on an emulated Z80 board and
drives an emulated Pioneer LD-V1000. Instead of disc video the screen shows
what the player is doing: mode, status byte, last command, current disc
frame, plus the cabinet's LED scoreboard. Disc video and audio streaming
from SD card is the next milestone.

ROM: build dlair.rom from MAME's dlair set (Rev F2) with tools/make_rom.py
and copy it to /Assets/dragonslair/common/.

Controls: D-pad = joystick, A/B = sword, Start = start 1, Select = coin 1,
Y = start 2, X = coin 2.

https://github.com/mcbeefy34/openfpga-dragonslair
